edition.en: The Countess Kathleen and Various Legends and Lyrics (1892), as transcribed on Wikisource
edition.zh: 据维基文库所录《凯瑟琳伯爵夫人及各种传说与抒情诗》（1892）

basis.en: First published in 1892; the author died in 1939.
basis.zh: 1892 年首次发表；作者卒于 1939 年。

note.en: A loose reworking of a sonnet by Ronsard. It imagines a future reader, old, by the fire, taking down “this book”, so the poem is about the very moment in which it is read. The “pilgrim soul” is the phrase people remember.
note.zh: 对龙沙一首十四行诗的自由改写。它想象一位未来的读者：老了，坐在炉火旁，取下“这本书”——所以这首诗写的恰恰是它被读到的那一刻。人们记住的是“朝圣者的灵魂”这个说法。

excerpt.orig:
But one man loved the pilgrim soul in you,
And loved the sorrows of your changing face;
excerpt.en:
But one man loved the pilgrim soul in you,
And loved the sorrows of your changing face;
excerpt.zh:
但有一个人爱你朝圣者的灵魂，
爱你变化的脸上的忧伤；

note.en: A loose reworking of Ronsard that imagines the moment it will be read; tender and shapely, with the pilgrim soul at its heart, in Yeats’s softer early manner.
note.zh: 化用龙沙，想象自己被读到的那一刻；温柔匀称，“朝圣的灵魂”是诗眼，仍属叶芝早期的柔婉风格。
